searchAdd: Type a stock to add to the watchlist
tRiseS: of all stocks are above their 10-month average price
secSellP: We think these will do worse than the Nifty, or the reason to own them has gone.
secWeakP: Our forecast is low, but nothing has broken. Worth a look; no hurry.
secNearP: Stocks you do not own whose chance is near the buy line. All of them are on the Worth following page.
secOddP: Something out of the ordinary happened in these watchlist stocks today. This is not a forecast.
fallTo: Sell at once if it falls to
noViewL: Our analyst has not looked at this stock. Ask, and the answer appears here after tonight's run. Up to 5 a day.
price1y: Nifty, last 1 year (through the Nifty BeES fund)
fPe: Price for 1 rupee of yearly profit
fRoeS: 15% or more a year is good.
fDe: Borrowing for each 1 rupee the owners put in
f200S: Below means the price has been falling for months.
fDd: Biggest fall in the last year
rankHow: Every evening we compare about 1,600 stocks with others in the same business on four things: how good the business is, how cheap it is, how strongly its price is rising, and how steady it is.
followP: Stocks our analyst looked at tonight that you do not own. None reached the buy line; these are the closest.
wlP: The stocks you chose to watch. Our view shows where the analyst looked at one tonight.
ideasP: The code's top 10 out of about 1,600 stocks tonight, and 10 that just missed. These are not forecasts until the analyst looks at them.
pRoomS: Long-term gains you can still book this year without tax.
pOpp: Worth a look for the portfolio
rEarlyS: of winners rose further within 3 months
fbS: Write anything: what you want, what you like, what you do not. Every evening the app reads it and shows below what it did.
sent: Sent. Tomorrow evening you will see what we did with it.
dismissed: You will not see it again.
asked: Asked. The forecast appears here in about 15 minutes.
fail: That did not go through. Please try again in a minute.
noHist: No price history for this stock yet.
noData: We have no numbers for this stock yet.
eyeP: Not calls. Stocks that came close to a buy, or did something unusual today.
allCallsP: Every call from tonight's run. Click a row for the full reasoning.
fundsP: Every fund is ranked against funds of the same kind over the last 3 years. Cost, steadiness and the worst fall come with each one. A good record is a reason to look closer, not a promise.
noFunds: No mutual funds in your holdings.
rCallsS: Not scored yet: the first results arrive about 3 months after a call.
setP: The few things you can change. Everything else runs by itself.
setBudgetP: The most we suggest you put into new buys this month.
budgetSet: Budget changed. It applies from the next run.
setHiddenNone: Nothing is hidden. Use the clock icon on a call to hide a stock for 30 days, or the cross to stop seeing it.
setLearned: What we learned from your choices
setLearnedNone: Nothing yet. When you remove several similar stocks for good, we show fewer like them and list it here.
setDataP: Everything refreshes by itself every evening. Use these only if a number looks old.
queued: Sent. It runs within a few minutes.
universeP: Every NSE, BSE and SME stock. Filter or type a name, then click a row.
uMissing: The list of all stocks is not published yet. It appears after the next nightly update.
uNone: No stock matches these filters. Try fewer filters.
rsuExpP: These have not happened yet. They are not counted above.
rsuTax: If you sold all of it today
rsuNoOrder: This is advice. Nothing is sold for you.
rsuFull: Lots and tax: open full page
pickOne: Pick a row from the list.
fundNote: A mutual fund. Its weekly review is in Our record.
wSell: Get out. The price hit our sell price, or the reason to own it has broken.
wWeak: Our forecast is low but nothing has broken. Worth a look, no hurry.
wBuy: Our forecast is good and it fits this month's budget.
wClose: Stocks you do not own that are nearest to our buy line.
wChance: Out of 100, how often stocks like this beat the Nifty over the next few months. Below 40 means sell, above 57 means buy.
wAvg: The usual price over the last 10 months. Above it is a rising trend.
setMixP: What you hold now against your target. The thin mark is the target.
approvedWait: Approved. Waiting for the next update.
packWait: Building the tax pack. It appears after the next update.
calLine: On this line, our chance matches what really happened.
calEmpty: Dots appear here once calls are old enough to score
hGapsP: Numbers we could not fill in, and why. They stay off the other screens until they are filled.
hFreshP: A full bar is today's data; it shrinks every day it is older.
hTokensP: When each login runs out. Renew before the bar is empty.
hRunChartP: One bar per run: taller took longer, red failed.
xRange: Where the price sits in its 1-year range
rzLimitedTip: Few similar cases in the past, so treat the chance with care.
fundNoMine: You hold no fund in this view.
fundSmallTip: Under 500 rupees crore of assets. Small funds can be merged or closed, so we never call them worth considering.
fxP: Every mutual fund, not only the ones we follow. Type a name, pick a kind or a fund house, and open any fund for its price chart, returns, falls, cost and overlap with what you own.
fxFind: Find a fund by name or fund house
fxNone: No fund matches. Try fewer letters or clear a filter.
fxUnavailable: The list of funds is not available right now. Try again in a little while.
fxMissing: We could not find that fund.
fxBuysP: Yellow dots are your own buys.
fxNoNav: We hold no price history for this fund yet.
fxFcP: Funds you hold or watch are reviewed every week. For any other fund, press the button.
fxFcNone: No forecast is possible for this fund.
fxNoFc: No forecast yet for this fund.
fxFailed: That did not finish. Try again in a few minutes.
fxFcOld: This forecast is out of date.
fxRetP: What the fund made each year, against the middle fund of its kind and against the Nifty.
fxTooYoung: The fund is too young for this.
fxRollT: Any 3 years you could have held
fxRollP: Start on any day since launch and hold for 3 years. This is the range of what you would have got.
fxFallT: How it fell in bad markets
fxFallP: The biggest drop from top to bottom in each bad patch for the market.
fxNoFalls: The fund did not exist in any of the big falls.
fxConsP: In how many 1-year stretches the fund did better than the others. Higher means steadier.
fxConsCat: Beat the middle fund of its kind
fxCostP: Cost is taken from your money every year, whether the fund does well or not. Direct has no agent, so it costs less.
fxSmall: A small fund, under 500 rupees crore. Small funds can be closed or merged.
fxOvP: How much of this fund is in shares you already hold. A high number means you would own the same thing twice.
fxOvNone: Overlap is only available for funds of the 10 biggest fund houses.
fxOvNoHold: You hold no shares we know of, so there is nothing to overlap.
fxOvZero: None of its shares are shares you hold.
fxOvOf: of this fund is in shares you hold.
wReview: You keep this one for years and its forecast has fallen. Look at it when you have time. We never say sell for one weak quarter.
askCap: No more questions for the analyst right now. It answers 5 a day, and none between 7 and 10 in the evening.
capAll: Too many requests right now. Try again later.
ltMarked: Marked. We will not call it a sell for one weak quarter.
ltUnmarked: No longer marked as held for years.
loadFail: Could not load more about this stock.
fbPrompt: What should we change, or what is missing?
fbNone: You have not sent anything yet.
tipWorth: What your shares of this stock are worth at today's price.
tipAim: The price we think it could rise to.
nextLogin: Next step: sign in to Kite again.
nextNone: Next step: none. Tonight's run tries again.
nextDoc: Next step: send the document again, or tell us in Feedback.
nextOwner: Next step: this is waiting for you. See the list above.
nextDefault: Next step: if it stays, tell us in Feedback.
nextIssue: Next step: open the issue link, or leave it. Tonight's run tries again.
nextSettings: Next step: open Settings and approve or decline.
reviewWhy: You keep this for years and its forecast fell. Take a look when you can.
